args.script:
# Count directories (excluding problem_directory itself)
dir_count=$(find problem_directory -type d | wc -l)
dir_count=$((dir_count - 1))  # exclude problem_directory itself

# Count files
file_count=$(find problem_directory -type f | wc -l)

# Total
total=$((dir_count + file_count))

echo "Directories (excluding problem_directory): $dir_count"
echo "Files: $file_count"
echo "Total: $total"
